trust_decision.summary: At the pinned commit EasyAdmin never decides inline-vs-download for an uploaded file: every anchor that points at a stored file is emitted without a download attribute and without inspecting the extension, so the browser's extension-derived Content-Type decides whether the file executes script in the admin origin; the fix moves that decision into one Twig filter applied at the three anchor sites.

landing_point.why: The report names FileField/ImageField and files 'served inline'; this template is the only place EasyAdmin renders an <a href> straight to a stored file for a FileField (FileField::new sets template 'crud/field/file' at src/Field/FileField.php:40), so a reader starts here. ImageField's own template has no anchor at all, which is what pushes the careful reader on into the form widgets.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The vich_file_widget block is a third-party uploader integration: it only renders when the app installs VichUploaderBundle and binds its VichFileType, and its href comes from Vich's own download_uri rather than from FileField/ImageField or EasyAdmin's configurators, so a solver can call it out of scope for this advisory.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Safe types must keep opening inline: raster images and PDFs keep the plain link in the field template and keep the 'view' (target=_blank) button on the form card with no download attribute, and the SVG preview/lightbox must keep rendering; an over-broad fix (download on every anchor, or removing view links/blocking extensions at upload) breaks exactly this.

O6_input_shapes: single filename string vs an array of files (multi-file field loop, module array on the card)
path-prefixed name such as uploads/files/payload.html - only the final extension counts
multi-dot names: archive.tar.svg is risky, archive.svg.zip is not
no extension / empty string is not risky
per-field boolean opt-out allowRiskyInlineRender(true|false) threaded from field option to form view var

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a client-side 'view' button for newly selected or existing cards
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the container already carries data-allow-view and data-icon-view (templates/crud/form_theme.html.twig:691,696) which this script never reads, so a maintainer adding the missing view affordance for JS-created cards would naturally reuse them and would need the same extension check in JS.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a 'view full size' link next to the vich_image_widget lightbox
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the block already receives download_uri and renders it in an ; adding an anchor to the original file is the obvious next step and is exactly the FileField/ImageField split the advisory describes.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: wrapping the avatar in an anchor to the original file
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: avatars are the one media field still rendered as a bare image; 'click the avatar to open the full file' is a routine feature request and would reach the same sink through a second template at distance.

O9_family: stored XSS (CWE-79) reached by rendering script-capable uploaded files inline, on an unrestricted-file-upload surface (CWE-434)
